verses.arabic: طه
verses.english: Ta Ha!
verses.transliteration_html: <u>Ta</u>h<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Taha

verses.arabic: مَآ أَنزَلْنَا عَلَيْكَ ٱلْقُرْءَانَ لِتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.english: We did not send down to you the Quran that you should be miserable,
verses.transliteration_html: M<u>a</u> anzaln<u>a</u> AAalayka alqur<u>a</u>na litashq<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Ma anzalna AAalayka alqurana litashqa

verses.arabic: إِلَّا تَذْكِرَةًۭ لِّمَن يَخْشَىٰ
verses.english: but only as an admonition to him who fears [his Lord].
verses.transliteration_html: Ill<u>a</u> ta<u>th</u>kiratan liman yakhsh<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Illa tathkiratan liman yakhsha

verses.arabic: تَنزِيلًۭا مِّمَّنْ خَلَقَ ٱلْأَرْضَ وَٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ ٱلْعُلَى
verses.english: A sending down [of the Revelation] from Him who created the earth and the lofty heavens
verses.transliteration_html: Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula
verses.transliteration_text: Tanzeelan mimman khalaqa alarda waalssamawati alAAula

verses.arabic: ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ عَلَى ٱلْعَرْشِ ٱسْتَوَىٰ
verses.english: —the All-beneficent, settled on the Throne.
verses.transliteration_html: Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa
verses.transliteration_text: Alrrahmanu AAala alAAarshi istawa

verses.arabic: لَهُۥ مَا فِى ٱلسَّمَـٰوَٰتِ وَمَا فِى ٱلْأَرْضِ وَمَا بَيْنَهُمَا وَمَا تَحْتَ ٱلثَّرَىٰ
verses.english: To Him belongs whatever is in the heavens and whatever is on the earth, and whatever is between them, and whatever is under the ground.
verses.transliteration_html: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara
verses.transliteration_text: Lahu ma fee alssamawati wama fee alardi wama baynahuma wama tahta alththara

verses.arabic: وَإِن تَجْهَرْ بِٱلْقَوْلِ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَعْلَمُ ٱلسِّرَّ وَأَخْفَى
verses.english: Whether you speak loudly [or in secret tones,] He indeed knows the secret and what is still more hidden.
verses.transliteration_html: Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa
verses.transliteration_text: Wain tajhar bialqawli fainnahu yaAAlamu alssirra waakhfa

verses.arabic: ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۖ لَهُ ٱلْأَسْمَآءُ ٱلْحُسْنَىٰ
verses.english: Allah—there is no god except Him—to Him belong the Best Names.
verses.transliteration_html: All<u>a</u>hu l<u>a</u> il<u>a</u>ha ill<u>a</u> huwa lahu alasm<u>a</u>o al<u>h</u>usn<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Allahu la ilaha illa huwa lahu alasmao alhusna

verses.arabic: وَهَلْ أَتَىٰكَ حَدِيثُ مُوسَىٰٓ
verses.english: Did the story of Moses come to you,
verses.transliteration_html: Wahal at<u>a</u>ka <u>h</u>adeethu moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Wahal ataka hadeethu moosa

verses.arabic: إِذْ رَءَا نَارًۭا فَقَالَ لِأَهْلِهِ ٱمْكُثُوٓا۟ إِنِّىٓ ءَانَسْتُ نَارًۭا لَّعَلِّىٓ ءَاتِيكُم مِّنْهَا بِقَبَسٍ أَوْ أَجِدُ عَلَى ٱلنَّارِ هُدًۭى
verses.english: when he sighted a fire, and said to his family, ‘Wait! Indeed, I descry a fire! Maybe I will bring you a brand from it, or find some guidance at the fire.’
verses.transliteration_html: Ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu AAala alnnari hudan
verses.transliteration_text: Ith raa naran faqala liahlihi omkuthoo innee anastu naran laAAallee ateekum minha biqabasin aw ajidu AAala alnnari hudan

verses.arabic: فَلَمَّآ أَتَىٰهَا نُودِىَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ
verses.english: So when he came to it, he was called, ‘O Moses!
verses.transliteration_html: Falamm<u>a</u> at<u>a</u>h<u>a</u> noodiya y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Falamma ataha noodiya ya moosa

verses.arabic: إِنِّىٓ أَنَا۠ رَبُّكَ فَٱخْلَعْ نَعْلَيْكَ ۖ إِنَّكَ بِٱلْوَادِ ٱلْمُقَدَّسِ طُوًۭى
verses.english: Indeed I am your Lord! So take off your sandals. You are indeed in the sacred valley of Tuwa.
verses.transliteration_html: Innee ana rabbuka faikhlaAA naAAlayka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan
verses.transliteration_text: Innee ana rabbuka faikhlaAA naAAlayka innaka bialwadi almuqaddasi tuwan

verses.arabic: وَأَنَا ٱخْتَرْتُكَ فَٱسْتَمِعْ لِمَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.english: I have chosen you; so listen to what is revealed.
verses.transliteration_html: Waana ikhtartuka faistamiAA lima yooha
verses.transliteration_text: Waana ikhtartuka faistamiAA lima yooha

verses.arabic: إِنَّنِىٓ أَنَا ٱللَّهُ لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّآ أَنَا۠ فَٱعْبُدْنِى وَأَقِمِ ٱلصَّلَوٰةَ لِذِكْرِىٓ
verses.english: Indeed I am Allah—there is no god except Me. So worship Me, and maintain the prayer for My remembrance.
verses.transliteration_html: Innanee ana Allahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree
verses.transliteration_text: Innanee ana Allahu la ilaha illa ana faoAAbudnee waaqimi alssalata lithikree

verses.arabic: إِنَّ ٱلسَّاعَةَ ءَاتِيَةٌ أَكَادُ أُخْفِيهَا لِتُجْزَىٰ كُلُّ نَفْسٍۭ بِمَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.english: Indeed the Hour is bound to come: I will have it hidden, so that every soul may be rewarded for its endeavour.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa
verses.transliteration_text: Inna alssaAAata atiyatun akadu okhfeeha litujza kullu nafsin bima tasAAa

verses.arabic: فَلَا يَصُدَّنَّكَ عَنْهَا مَن لَّا يُؤْمِنُ بِهَا وَٱتَّبَعَ هَوَىٰهُ فَتَرْدَىٰ
verses.english: So do not let yourself be distracted from it by those who do not believe in it and who follow their desires, or you will perish.’
verses.transliteration_html: Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda
verses.transliteration_text: Fala yasuddannaka AAanha man la yuminu biha waittabaAAa hawahu fatarda

verses.arabic: وَمَا تِلْكَ بِيَمِينِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.english: ‘Moses, what is that in your right hand?’
verses.transliteration_html: Wam<u>a</u> tilka biyameenika y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Wama tilka biyameenika ya moosa

verses.arabic: قَالَ هِىَ عَصَاىَ أَتَوَكَّؤُا۟ عَلَيْهَا وَأَهُشُّ بِهَا عَلَىٰ غَنَمِى وَلِىَ فِيهَا مَـَٔارِبُ أُخْرَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘It is my staff. I lean on it, and with it I beat down leaves for my sheep; and I have other uses for it.’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la hiya AAa<u>sa</u>ya atawakkao AAalayh<u>a</u> waahushshu bih<u>a</u> AAal<u>a</u> ghanamee waliya feeh<u>a</u> ma<u>a</u>ribu okhr<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala hiya AAasaya atawakkao AAalayha waahushshu biha AAala ghanamee waliya feeha maaribu okhra

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَلْقِهَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘Moses, throw it down.’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la alqih<u>a</u> y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala alqiha ya moosa

verses.arabic: فَأَلْقَىٰهَا فَإِذَا هِىَ حَيَّةٌۭ تَسْعَىٰ
verses.english: So he threw it down, and behold, it was a snake, moving swiftly.
verses.transliteration_html: Faalq<u>a</u>h<u>a</u> fai<u>tha</u> hiya <u>h</u>ayyatun tasAA<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Faalqaha faitha hiya hayyatun tasAAa

verses.arabic: قَالَ خُذْهَا وَلَا تَخَفْ ۖ سَنُعِيدُهَا سِيرَتَهَا ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘Take hold of it, and do not fear. We will restore it to its former state.
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la khu<u>th</u>h<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> takhaf sanuAAeeduh<u>a</u> seeratah<u>a</u> alool<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala khuthha wala takhaf sanuAAeeduha seerataha aloola

verses.arabic: وَٱضْمُمْ يَدَكَ إِلَىٰ جَنَاحِكَ تَخْرُجْ بَيْضَآءَ مِنْ غَيْرِ سُوٓءٍ ءَايَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.english: Now clasp your hand to your armpit: it will emerge white, without any harm—[this is yet] another sign,
verses.transliteration_html: Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra
verses.transliteration_text: Waodmum yadaka ila janahika takhruj baydaa min ghayri sooin ayatan okhra

verses.arabic: لِنُرِيَكَ مِنْ ءَايَـٰتِنَا ٱلْكُبْرَى
verses.english: that We may show you some of Our great signs.
verses.transliteration_html: Linuriyaka min <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tin<u>a</u> alkubr<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Linuriyaka min ayatina alkubra

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.english: Go to Pharaoh. He has indeed rebelled.’
verses.transliteration_html: I<u>th</u>hab il<u>a</u> firAAawna innahu <u>t</u>agh<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Ithhab ila firAAawna innahu tagha

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ ٱشْرَحْ لِى صَدْرِى
verses.english: He said, ‘My Lord! Open my breast for me.
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la rabbi ishra<u>h</u> lee <u>s</u>adree
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi ishrah lee sadree

verses.arabic: وَيَسِّرْ لِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.english: Make my task easy for me.
verses.transliteration_html: Wayassir lee amree
verses.transliteration_text: Wayassir lee amree

verses.arabic: وَٱحْلُلْ عُقْدَةًۭ مِّن لِّسَانِى
verses.english: Remove the hitch from my tongue,
verses.transliteration_html: Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee
verses.transliteration_text: Waohlul AAuqdatan min lisanee

verses.arabic: يَفْقَهُوا۟ قَوْلِى
verses.english: [so that] they may understand my speech.
verses.transliteration_html: Yafqahoo qawlee
verses.transliteration_text: Yafqahoo qawlee

verses.arabic: وَٱجْعَل لِّى وَزِيرًۭا مِّنْ أَهْلِى
verses.english: Appoint for me a minister from my family,
verses.transliteration_html: WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee
verses.transliteration_text: WaijAAal lee wazeeran min ahlee

verses.arabic: هَـٰرُونَ أَخِى
verses.english: Aaron, my brother.
verses.transliteration_html: H<u>a</u>roona akhee
verses.transliteration_text: Haroona akhee

verses.arabic: ٱشْدُدْ بِهِۦٓ أَزْرِى
verses.english: Strengthen my back through him,
verses.transliteration_html: Oshdud bihi azree
verses.transliteration_text: Oshdud bihi azree

verses.arabic: وَأَشْرِكْهُ فِىٓ أَمْرِى
verses.english: and make him my associate in my task,
verses.transliteration_html: Waashrikhu fee amree
verses.transliteration_text: Waashrikhu fee amree

verses.arabic: كَىْ نُسَبِّحَكَ كَثِيرًۭا
verses.english: so that we may glorify You greatly,
verses.transliteration_html: Kay nusabbihaka katheeran
verses.transliteration_text: Kay nusabbihaka katheeran

verses.arabic: وَنَذْكُرَكَ كَثِيرًا
verses.english: and remember You greatly.
verses.transliteration_html: Wanathkuraka katheeran
verses.transliteration_text: Wanathkuraka katheeran

verses.arabic: إِنَّكَ كُنتَ بِنَا بَصِيرًۭا
verses.english: Indeed You see us best.’
verses.transliteration_html: Innaka kunta bina baseeran
verses.transliteration_text: Innaka kunta bina baseeran

verses.arabic: قَالَ قَدْ أُوتِيتَ سُؤْلَكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘Moses, your request has been granted!
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la qad ooteeta sulaka y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala qad ooteeta sulaka ya moosa

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ مَنَنَّا عَلَيْكَ مَرَّةً أُخْرَىٰٓ
verses.english: Certainly, We have done you a favour another time,
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad manann<u>a</u> AAalayka marratan okhr<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad mananna AAalayka marratan okhra

verses.arabic: إِذْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ مَا يُوحَىٰٓ
verses.english: when We revealed to your mother whatever was to be revealed:
verses.transliteration_html: I<u>th</u> aw<u>h</u>ayn<u>a</u> il<u>a</u> ommika m<u>a</u> yoo<u>ha</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Ith awhayna ila ommika ma yooha

verses.arabic: أَنِ ٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلتَّابُوتِ فَٱقْذِفِيهِ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ فَلْيُلْقِهِ ٱلْيَمُّ بِٱلسَّاحِلِ يَأْخُذْهُ عَدُوٌّۭ لِّى وَعَدُوٌّۭ لَّهُۥ ۚ وَأَلْقَيْتُ عَلَيْكَ مَحَبَّةًۭ مِّنِّى وَلِتُصْنَعَ عَلَىٰ عَيْنِىٓ
verses.english: “Put him in the casket, and cast it into the river. Then the river will cast it on the bank, and he shall be picked up by an enemy of Mine and an enemy of his.” And I made you endearing, and that you might be reared under My [watchful] eyes.
verses.transliteration_html: Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee
verses.transliteration_text: Ani iqthifeehi fee alttabooti faiqthifeehi fee alyammi falyulqihi alyammu bialssahili yakhuthhu AAaduwwun lee waAAaduwwun lahu waalqaytu AAalayka mahabbatan minnee walitusnaAAa AAala AAaynee

verses.arabic: إِذْ تَمْشِىٓ أُخْتُكَ فَتَقُولُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكُمْ عَلَىٰ مَن يَكْفُلُهُۥ ۖ فَرَجَعْنَـٰكَ إِلَىٰٓ أُمِّكَ كَىْ تَقَرَّ عَيْنُهَا وَلَا تَحْزَنَ ۚ وَقَتَلْتَ نَفْسًۭا فَنَجَّيْنَـٰكَ مِنَ ٱلْغَمِّ وَفَتَنَّـٰكَ فُتُونًۭا ۚ فَلَبِثْتَ سِنِينَ فِىٓ أَهْلِ مَدْيَنَ ثُمَّ جِئْتَ عَلَىٰ قَدَرٍۢ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.english: When your sister walked up [to Pharaoh’s palace] saying, “Shall I show you someone who will take care of him?” Then We restored you to your mother, that she might not grieve and be comforted. Then you slew a soul, whereupon We delivered you from anguish, and We tried you with various ordeals. Then you stayed for several years among the people of Midian. Then you turned up as ordained, O Moses!
verses.transliteration_html: I<u>th</u> tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAal<u>a</u> man yakfuluhu farajaAAn<u>a</u>ka il<u>a</u> ommika kay taqarra AAaynuh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> ta<u>h</u>zana waqatalta nafsan fanajjayn<u>a</u>ka mina alghammi wafatann<u>a</u>ka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAal<u>a</u> qadarin y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Ith tamshee okhtuka fataqoolu hal adullukum AAala man yakfuluhu farajaAAnaka ila ommika kay taqarra AAaynuha wala tahzana waqatalta nafsan fanajjaynaka mina alghammi wafatannaka futoonan falabithta sineena fee ahli madyana thumma jita AAala qadarin ya moosa

verses.arabic: وَٱصْطَنَعْتُكَ لِنَفْسِى
verses.english: And I chose you for Myself.’
verses.transliteration_html: WaistanaAAtuka linafsee
verses.transliteration_text: WaistanaAAtuka linafsee

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبْ أَنتَ وَأَخُوكَ بِـَٔايَـٰتِى وَلَا تَنِيَا فِى ذِكْرِى
verses.english: ‘Go ahead, you and your brother, with My signs and do not flag in My remembrance.
verses.transliteration_html: I<u>th</u>hab anta waakhooka bi<u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tee wal<u>a</u> taniy<u>a</u> fee <u>th</u>ikree
verses.transliteration_text: Ithhab anta waakhooka biayatee wala taniya fee thikree

verses.arabic: ٱذْهَبَآ إِلَىٰ فِرْعَوْنَ إِنَّهُۥ طَغَىٰ
verses.english: Both of you go to Pharaoh, for he has indeed rebelled.
verses.transliteration_html: I<u>th</u>hab<u>a</u> il<u>a</u> firAAawna innahu <u>t</u>agh<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Ithhaba ila firAAawna innahu tagha

verses.arabic: فَقُولَا لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا لَّيِّنًۭا لَّعَلَّهُۥ يَتَذَكَّرُ أَوْ يَخْشَىٰ
verses.english: Speak to him in a soft manner; maybe he will take admonition or fear.’
verses.transliteration_html: Faqool<u>a</u> lahu qawlan layyinan laAAallahu yata<u>th</u>akkaru aw yakhsh<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Faqoola lahu qawlan layyinan laAAallahu yatathakkaru aw yakhsha

verses.arabic: قَالَا رَبَّنَآ إِنَّنَا نَخَافُ أَن يَفْرُطَ عَلَيْنَآ أَوْ أَن يَطْغَىٰ
verses.english: They said, ‘Our Lord! We are indeed afraid that he will forestall us or will exceed all bounds.’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>l<u>a</u> rabban<u>a</u> innan<u>a</u> nakh<u>a</u>fu an yafru<u>t</u>a AAalayn<u>a</u> aw an ya<u>t</u>gh<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbana innana nakhafu an yafruta AAalayna aw an yatgha

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَا تَخَافَآ ۖ إِنَّنِى مَعَكُمَآ أَسْمَعُ وَأَرَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘Do not be afraid, for I will be with the two of you, hearing and seeing [whatever happens].
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la l<u>a</u> takh<u>a</u>f<u>a</u> innanee maAAakum<u>a</u> asmaAAu waar<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala la takhafa innanee maAAakuma asmaAAu waara

verses.arabic: فَأْتِيَاهُ فَقُولَآ إِنَّا رَسُولَا رَبِّكَ فَأَرْسِلْ مَعَنَا بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَا تُعَذِّبْهُمْ ۖ قَدْ جِئْنَـٰكَ بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّكَ ۖ وَٱلسَّلَـٰمُ عَلَىٰ مَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ ٱلْهُدَىٰٓ
verses.english: So approach him and say, ‘‘We are the apostles of your Lord. Let the Children of Israel go with us, and do not torture them! We certainly bring you a sign from your Lord, and may peace be upon him who follows guidance!
verses.transliteration_html: Fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil maAAana banee israeela wala tuAAaththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu AAala mani ittabaAAa alhuda
verses.transliteration_text: Fatiyahu faqoola inna rasoola rabbika faarsil maAAana banee israeela wala tuAAaththibhum qad jinaka biayatin min rabbika waalssalamu AAala mani ittabaAAa alhuda

verses.arabic: إِنَّا قَدْ أُوحِىَ إِلَيْنَآ أَنَّ ٱلْعَذَابَ عَلَىٰ مَن كَذَّبَ وَتَوَلَّىٰ
verses.english: Indeed it has been revealed to us that punishment shall befall those who impugn us and turn their backs [on us].’’ ’
verses.transliteration_html: Inn<u>a</u> qad oo<u>h</u>iya ilayn<u>a</u> anna alAAa<u>tha</u>ba AAal<u>a</u> man ka<u>thth</u>aba watawall<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Inna qad oohiya ilayna anna alAAathaba AAala man kaththaba watawalla

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَن رَّبُّكُمَا يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘Who is your Lord, Moses?’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la faman rabbukum<u>a</u> y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala faman rabbukuma ya moosa

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبُّنَا ٱلَّذِىٓ أَعْطَىٰ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ خَلْقَهُۥ ثُمَّ هَدَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘Our Lord is He who gave everything its creation and then guided it.’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la rabbun<u>a</u> alla<u>th</u>ee aAA<u>ta</u> kulla shayin khalqahu thumma had<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbuna allathee aAAta kulla shayin khalqahu thumma hada

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا بَالُ ٱلْقُرُونِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘What about the former generations?’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la fam<u>a</u> b<u>a</u>lu alqurooni alool<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala fama balu alqurooni aloola

verses.arabic: قَالَ عِلْمُهَا عِندَ رَبِّى فِى كِتَـٰبٍۢ ۖ لَّا يَضِلُّ رَبِّى وَلَا يَنسَى
verses.english: He said, ‘Their knowledge is with my Lord, in a Book. My Lord neither makes any error nor forgets.’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la AAilmuh<u>a</u> AAinda rabbee fee kit<u>a</u>bin l<u>a</u> ya<u>d</u>illu rabbee wal<u>a</u> yans<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala AAilmuha AAinda rabbee fee kitabin la yadillu rabbee wala yansa

verses.arabic: ٱلَّذِى جَعَلَ لَكُمُ ٱلْأَرْضَ مَهْدًۭا وَسَلَكَ لَكُمْ فِيهَا سُبُلًۭا وَأَنزَلَ مِنَ ٱلسَّمَآءِ مَآءًۭ فَأَخْرَجْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّن نَّبَاتٍۢ شَتَّىٰ
verses.english: He, who made the earth for you a cradle, and in it threaded for you ways, and sent down water from the sky, and with it We brought forth various kinds of vegetation.
verses.transliteration_html: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta
verses.transliteration_text: Allathee jaAAala lakumu alarda mahdan wasalaka lakum feeha subulan waanzala mina alssamai maan faakhrajna bihi azwajan min nabatin shatta

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ وَٱرْعَوْا۟ أَنْعَـٰمَكُمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.english: ‘Eat and pasture your cattle.’ There are indeed signs in that for those who have sense.
verses.transliteration_html: Kuloo wairAAaw anAAamakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha
verses.transliteration_text: Kuloo wairAAaw anAAamakum inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

verses.arabic: ۞ مِنْهَا خَلَقْنَـٰكُمْ وَفِيهَا نُعِيدُكُمْ وَمِنْهَا نُخْرِجُكُمْ تَارَةً أُخْرَىٰ
verses.english: From it did We create you, into it shall We return you, and from it shall We bring you forth another time.
verses.transliteration_html: Minh<u>a</u> khalaqn<u>a</u>kum wafeeh<u>a</u> nuAAeedukum waminh<u>a</u> nukhrijukum t<u>a</u>ratan okhr<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Minha khalaqnakum wafeeha nuAAeedukum waminha nukhrijukum taratan okhra

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَرَيْنَـٰهُ ءَايَـٰتِنَا كُلَّهَا فَكَذَّبَ وَأَبَىٰ
verses.english: Certainly We showed him all Our signs. But he denied [them] and refused [to believe them].
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad arayn<u>a</u>hu <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tin<u>a</u> kullah<u>a</u> faka<u>thth</u>aba waab<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad araynahu ayatina kullaha fakaththaba waaba

verses.arabic: قَالَ أَجِئْتَنَا لِتُخْرِجَنَا مِنْ أَرْضِنَا بِسِحْرِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘Moses, have you come to us to expel us from our land with your magic?
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la ajitan<u>a</u> litukhrijan<u>a</u> min ar<u>d</u>in<u>a</u> bisi<u>h</u>rika y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala ajitana litukhrijana min ardina bisihrika ya moosa

verses.arabic: فَلَنَأْتِيَنَّكَ بِسِحْرٍۢ مِّثْلِهِۦ فَٱجْعَلْ بَيْنَنَا وَبَيْنَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّا نُخْلِفُهُۥ نَحْنُ وَلَآ أَنتَ مَكَانًۭا سُوًۭى
verses.english: Yet we [too] will bring you a magic like it! So fix a tryst between us and you, which neither we shall fail nor you, at a middle place.’
verses.transliteration_html: Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faijAAal baynana wabaynaka mawAAidan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan
verses.transliteration_text: Falanatiyannaka bisihrin mithlihi faijAAal baynana wabaynaka mawAAidan la nukhlifuhu nahnu wala anta makanan suwan

verses.arabic: قَالَ مَوْعِدُكُمْ يَوْمُ ٱلزِّينَةِ وَأَن يُحْشَرَ ٱلنَّاسُ ضُحًۭى
verses.english: He said, ‘Your tryst shall be the Day of Adornment, and let the people be assembled in early forenoon.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala mawAAidukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala mawAAidukum yawmu alzzeenati waan yuhshara alnnasu duhan

verses.arabic: فَتَوَلَّىٰ فِرْعَوْنُ فَجَمَعَ كَيْدَهُۥ ثُمَّ أَتَىٰ
verses.english: Then Pharaoh withdrew [to consult privately], summoned up his guile, and then arrived [at the scene of the contest].
verses.transliteration_html: Fatawall<u>a</u> firAAawnu fajamaAAa kaydahu thumma at<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Fatawalla firAAawnu fajamaAAa kaydahu thumma ata

verses.arabic: قَالَ لَهُم مُّوسَىٰ وَيْلَكُمْ لَا تَفْتَرُوا۟ عَلَى ٱللَّهِ كَذِبًۭا فَيُسْحِتَكُم بِعَذَابٍۢ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنِ ٱفْتَرَىٰ
verses.english: Moses said to them, ‘Woe to you! Do not fabricate lies against Allah, or He will obliterate you with a punishment. Whoever fabricates lies certainly fails.’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la lahum moos<u>a</u> waylakum l<u>a</u> taftaroo AAal<u>a</u> All<u>a</u>hi ka<u>th</u>iban fayus<u>h</u>itakum biAAa<u>tha</u>bin waqad kh<u>a</u>ba mani iftar<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala lahum moosa waylakum la taftaroo AAala Allahi kathiban fayushitakum biAAathabin waqad khaba mani iftara

verses.arabic: فَتَنَـٰزَعُوٓا۟ أَمْرَهُم بَيْنَهُمْ وَأَسَرُّوا۟ ٱلنَّجْوَىٰ
verses.english: So they disputed their matter among themselves, and kept their confidential talks secret.
verses.transliteration_html: FatanazaAAoo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa
verses.transliteration_text: FatanazaAAoo amrahum baynahum waasarroo alnnajwa

verses.arabic: قَالُوٓا۟ إِنْ هَـٰذَٰنِ لَسَـٰحِرَٰنِ يُرِيدَانِ أَن يُخْرِجَاكُم مِّنْ أَرْضِكُم بِسِحْرِهِمَا وَيَذْهَبَا بِطَرِيقَتِكُمُ ٱلْمُثْلَىٰ
verses.english: They said, ‘These two are indeed magicians who intend to expel you from your land with their magic, and to abolish your excellent tradition!
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>loo in h<u>atha</u>ni las<u>ah</u>ir<u>a</u>ni yureed<u>a</u>ni an yukhrij<u>a</u>kum min ar<u>d</u>ikum bisi<u>h</u>rihim<u>a</u> waya<u>th</u>hab<u>a</u> bi<u>t</u>areeqatikumu almuthl<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo in hathani lasahirani yureedani an yukhrijakum min ardikum bisihrihima wayathhaba bitareeqatikumu almuthla

verses.arabic: فَأَجْمِعُوا۟ كَيْدَكُمْ ثُمَّ ٱئْتُوا۟ صَفًّۭا ۚ وَقَدْ أَفْلَحَ ٱلْيَوْمَ مَنِ ٱسْتَعْلَىٰ
verses.english: So summon up your ingenuity, then come in ranks. Today he who has the upper hand will be felicitous!’
verses.transliteration_html: FaajmiAAoo kaydakum thumma itoo <u>s</u>affan waqad afla<u>h</u>a alyawma mani istaAAl<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: FaajmiAAoo kaydakum thumma itoo saffan waqad aflaha alyawma mani istaAAla

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ يَـٰمُوسَىٰٓ إِمَّآ أَن تُلْقِىَ وَإِمَّآ أَن نَّكُونَ أَوَّلَ مَنْ أَلْقَىٰ
verses.english: They said, ‘O Moses! Will you throw first, or shall we?’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>loo y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u> imm<u>a</u> an tulqiya waimm<u>a</u> an nakoona awwala man alq<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo ya moosa imma an tulqiya waimma an nakoona awwala man alqa

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَلْ أَلْقُوا۟ ۖ فَإِذَا حِبَالُهُمْ وَعِصِيُّهُمْ يُخَيَّلُ إِلَيْهِ مِن سِحْرِهِمْ أَنَّهَا تَسْعَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘No, you throw first.’ Thereupon, behold, their ropes and staffs appeared to him by their magic to wriggle swiftly.
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la bal alqoo fai<u>tha</u> <u>h</u>ib<u>a</u>luhum waAAi<u>s</u>iyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min si<u>h</u>rihim annah<u>a</u> tasAA<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala bal alqoo faitha hibaluhum waAAisiyyuhum yukhayyalu ilayhi min sihrihim annaha tasAAa

verses.arabic: فَأَوْجَسَ فِى نَفْسِهِۦ خِيفَةًۭ مُّوسَىٰ
verses.english: Then Moses felt a fear within his heart.
verses.transliteration_html: Faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Faawjasa fee nafsihi kheefatan moosa

verses.arabic: قُلْنَا لَا تَخَفْ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلْأَعْلَىٰ
verses.english: We said, ‘Do not be afraid. Indeed, you will have the upper hand.
verses.transliteration_html: Quln<u>a</u> l<u>a</u> takhaf innaka anta alaAAl<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qulna la takhaf innaka anta alaAAla

verses.arabic: وَأَلْقِ مَا فِى يَمِينِكَ تَلْقَفْ مَا صَنَعُوٓا۟ ۖ إِنَّمَا صَنَعُوا۟ كَيْدُ سَـٰحِرٍۢ ۖ وَلَا يُفْلِحُ ٱلسَّاحِرُ حَيْثُ أَتَىٰ
verses.english: Throw down what is in your right hand, and it will swallow what they have conjured. What they have conjured is only a magician’s trick, and the magician does not fare well wherever he may show up.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sanaAAoo innama sanaAAoo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata
verses.transliteration_text: Waalqi ma fee yameenika talqaf ma sanaAAoo innama sanaAAoo kaydu sahirin wala yuflihu alssahiru haythu ata

verses.arabic: فَأُلْقِىَ ٱلسَّحَرَةُ سُجَّدًۭا قَالُوٓا۟ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّ هَـٰرُونَ وَمُوسَىٰ
verses.english: Thereat the magicians fell down prostrating. They said, ‘We have believed in the Lord of Aaron and Moses!’
verses.transliteration_html: Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa
verses.transliteration_text: Faolqiya alssaharatu sujjadan qaloo amanna birabbi haroona wamoosa

verses.arabic: قَالَ ءَامَنتُمْ لَهُۥ قَبْلَ أَنْ ءَاذَنَ لَكُمْ ۖ إِنَّهُۥ لَكَبِيرُكُمُ ٱلَّذِى عَلَّمَكُمُ ٱلسِّحْرَ ۖ فَلَأُقَطِّعَنَّ أَيْدِيَكُمْ وَأَرْجُلَكُم مِّنْ خِلَـٰفٍۢ وَلَأُصَلِّبَنَّكُمْ فِى جُذُوعِ ٱلنَّخْلِ وَلَتَعْلَمُنَّ أَيُّنَآ أَشَدُّ عَذَابًۭا وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘Did you believe in him before I should permit you? He is indeed your chief who has taught you magic! Surely, I will cut off your hands and feet from opposite sides, and I will crucify you on the trunks of palm trees, and you will know which of us can inflict a severer and more lasting punishment.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falaoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthooAAi alnnakhli walataAAlamunna ayyuna ashaddu AAathaban waabqa
verses.transliteration_text: Qala amantum lahu qabla an athana lakum innahu lakabeerukumu allathee AAallamakumu alssihra falaoqattiAAanna aydiyakum waarjulakum min khilafin walaosallibannakum fee juthooAAi alnnakhli walataAAlamunna ayyuna ashaddu AAathaban waabqa

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نُّؤْثِرَكَ عَلَىٰ مَا جَآءَنَا مِنَ ٱلْبَيِّنَـٰتِ وَٱلَّذِى فَطَرَنَا ۖ فَٱقْضِ مَآ أَنتَ قَاضٍ ۖ إِنَّمَا تَقْضِى هَـٰذِهِ ٱلْحَيَوٰةَ ٱلدُّنْيَآ
verses.english: They said, ‘We will never prefer you to the clear proofs which have come to us, and to Him who originated us. Decide whatever you want to decide. You can only decide about the life of this world.
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo lan nuthiraka AAala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo lan nuthiraka AAala ma jaana mina albayyinati waallathee fatarana faiqdi ma anta qadin innama taqdee hathihi alhayata alddunya

verses.arabic: إِنَّآ ءَامَنَّا بِرَبِّنَا لِيَغْفِرَ لَنَا خَطَـٰيَـٰنَا وَمَآ أَكْرَهْتَنَا عَلَيْهِ مِنَ ٱلسِّحْرِ ۗ وَٱللَّهُ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.english: We have indeed believed in our Lord that He may forgive us our offences and the magic you compelled us to perform. Allah is better and more lasting.’
verses.transliteration_html: Inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana AAalayhi mina alssihri waAllahu khayrun waabqa
verses.transliteration_text: Inna amanna birabbina liyaghfira lana khatayana wama akrahtana AAalayhi mina alssihri waAllahu khayrun waabqa

verses.arabic: إِنَّهُۥ مَن يَأْتِ رَبَّهُۥ مُجْرِمًۭا فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ جَهَنَّمَ لَا يَمُوتُ فِيهَا وَلَا يَحْيَىٰ
verses.english: Whoever comes to his Lord laden with guilt, for him shall be hell, where he will neither live nor die.
verses.transliteration_html: Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama l<u>a</u> yamootu feeh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> ya<u>h</u>y<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Innahu man yati rabbahu mujriman fainna lahu jahannama la yamootu feeha wala yahya

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَأْتِهِۦ مُؤْمِنًۭا قَدْ عَمِلَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ فَأُو۟لَـٰٓئِكَ لَهُمُ ٱلدَّرَجَـٰتُ ٱلْعُلَىٰ
verses.english: But whoever comes to Him with faith and he has done righteous deeds, for such shall be the highest ranks
verses.transliteration_html: Waman yatihi muminan qad AAamila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu alAAula
verses.transliteration_text: Waman yatihi muminan qad AAamila alssalihati faolaika lahumu alddarajatu alAAula

verses.arabic: جَنَّـٰتُ عَدْنٍۢ تَجْرِى مِن تَحْتِهَا ٱلْأَنْهَـٰرُ خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهَا ۚ وَذَٰلِكَ جَزَآءُ مَن تَزَكَّىٰ
verses.english: —the Gardens of Eden, with streams running in them, to abide in them [forever], and that is the reward of him who keeps pure.
verses.transliteration_html: Jann<u>a</u>tu AA<u>a</u>dnin tajree min ta<u>h</u>tih<u>a</u> alanh<u>a</u>ru kh<u>a</u>lideena feeh<u>a</u> wa<u>tha</u>lika jaz<u>a</u>o man tazakk<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Jannatu AAadnin tajree min tahtiha alanharu khalideena feeha wathalika jazao man tazakka

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ أَوْحَيْنَآ إِلَىٰ مُوسَىٰٓ أَنْ أَسْرِ بِعِبَادِى فَٱضْرِبْ لَهُمْ طَرِيقًۭا فِى ٱلْبَحْرِ يَبَسًۭا لَّا تَخَـٰفُ دَرَكًۭا وَلَا تَخْشَىٰ
verses.english: We revealed to Moses, [saying], ‘Set out with My servants at night, and strike out for them a dry path through the sea. Do not be afraid of being overtaken, and have no fear [of getting drowned].
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad awhayna ila moosa an asri biAAibadee faidrib lahum tareeqan fee albahri yabasan la takhafu darakan wala takhsha

verses.arabic: فَأَتْبَعَهُمْ فِرْعَوْنُ بِجُنُودِهِۦ فَغَشِيَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْيَمِّ مَا غَشِيَهُمْ
verses.english: Then Pharaoh pursued them with his troops, whereat they were engulfed by what engulfed them of the sea.
verses.transliteration_html: FaatbaAAahum firAAawnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi m<u>a</u> ghashiyahum
verses.transliteration_text: FaatbaAAahum firAAawnu bijunoodihi faghashiyahum mina alyammi ma ghashiyahum

verses.arabic: وَأَضَلَّ فِرْعَوْنُ قَوْمَهُۥ وَمَا هَدَىٰ
verses.english: Pharaoh led his people astray and did not guide them.
verses.transliteration_html: Waa<u>d</u>alla firAAawnu qawmahu wam<u>a</u> had<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Waadalla firAAawnu qawmahu wama hada

verses.arabic: يَـٰبَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ قَدْ أَنجَيْنَـٰكُم مِّنْ عَدُوِّكُمْ وَوَٰعَدْنَـٰكُمْ جَانِبَ ٱلطُّورِ ٱلْأَيْمَنَ وَنَزَّلْنَا عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْمَنَّ وَٱلسَّلْوَىٰ
verses.english: O Children of Israel! We delivered you from your enemy, and We appointed with you a tryst on the right side of the Mount and We sent down to you manna and quails:
verses.transliteration_html: Ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min AAaduwwikum wawaAAadnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa
verses.transliteration_text: Ya banee israeela qad anjaynakum min AAaduwwikum wawaAAadnakum janiba alttoori alaymana wanazzalna AAalaykumu almanna waalssalwa

verses.arabic: كُلُوا۟ مِن طَيِّبَـٰتِ مَا رَزَقْنَـٰكُمْ وَلَا تَطْغَوْا۟ فِيهِ فَيَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبِى ۖ وَمَن يَحْلِلْ عَلَيْهِ غَضَبِى فَقَدْ هَوَىٰ
verses.english: ‘Eat of the good things We have provided you, but do not overstep the bounds therein, lest My wrath should descend on you, and he on whom My wrath descends certainly perishes.
verses.transliteration_html: Kuloo min <u>t</u>ayyib<u>a</u>ti m<u>a</u> razaqn<u>a</u>kum wal<u>a</u> ta<u>t</u>ghaw feehi faya<u>h</u>illa AAalaykum gha<u>d</u>abee waman ya<u>h</u>lil AAalayhi gha<u>d</u>abee faqad haw<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Kuloo min tayyibati ma razaqnakum wala tatghaw feehi fayahilla AAalaykum ghadabee waman yahlil AAalayhi ghadabee faqad hawa

verses.arabic: وَإِنِّى لَغَفَّارٌۭ لِّمَن تَابَ وَءَامَنَ وَعَمِلَ صَـٰلِحًۭا ثُمَّ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.english: Indeed I forgive those who repent, become faithful, act righteously, and follow guidance.’
verses.transliteration_html: Wainnee laghaff<u>a</u>run liman t<u>a</u>ba wa<u>a</u>mana waAAamila <u>sa</u>li<u>h</u>an thumma ihtad<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Wainnee laghaffarun liman taba waamana waAAamila salihan thumma ihtada

verses.arabic: ۞ وَمَآ أَعْجَلَكَ عَن قَوْمِكَ يَـٰمُوسَىٰ
verses.english: [God said,] ‘O Moses, what has prompted you to hasten ahead of your people?’
verses.transliteration_html: Wam<u>a</u> aAAjalaka AAan qawmika y<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Wama aAAjalaka AAan qawmika ya moosa

verses.arabic: قَالَ هُمْ أُو۟لَآءِ عَلَىٰٓ أَثَرِى وَعَجِلْتُ إِلَيْكَ رَبِّ لِتَرْضَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘They are close upon my heels, and I hurried on to You, my Lord, that You may be pleased.’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la hum ol<u>a</u>i AAal<u>a</u> atharee waAAajiltu ilayka rabbi litar<u>da</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala hum olai AAala atharee waAAajiltu ilayka rabbi litarda

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَإِنَّا قَدْ فَتَنَّا قَوْمَكَ مِنۢ بَعْدِكَ وَأَضَلَّهُمُ ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.english: He said, ‘Indeed We tried your people in your absence, and the Samiri has led them astray.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala fainna qad fatanna qawmaka min baAAdika waadallahumu alssamiriyyu
verses.transliteration_text: Qala fainna qad fatanna qawmaka min baAAdika waadallahumu alssamiriyyu

verses.arabic: فَرَجَعَ مُوسَىٰٓ إِلَىٰ قَوْمِهِۦ غَضْبَـٰنَ أَسِفًۭا ۚ قَالَ يَـٰقَوْمِ أَلَمْ يَعِدْكُمْ رَبُّكُمْ وَعْدًا حَسَنًا ۚ أَفَطَالَ عَلَيْكُمُ ٱلْعَهْدُ أَمْ أَرَدتُّمْ أَن يَحِلَّ عَلَيْكُمْ غَضَبٌۭ مِّن رَّبِّكُمْ فَأَخْلَفْتُم مَّوْعِدِى
verses.english: Thereupon Moses returned to his people, indignant and grieved. He said, ‘O my people! Did your Lord not give you a true promise? Did the period [of my absence] seem too long to you? Or did you desire that your Lord’s wrath should descend on you and so you failed your tryst with me?’
verses.transliteration_html: FarajaAAa moos<u>a</u> il<u>a</u> qawmihi gha<u>d</u>b<u>a</u>na asifan q<u>a</u>la y<u>a</u> qawmi alam yaAAidkum rabbukum waAAdan <u>h</u>asanan afa<u>ta</u>la AAalaykumu alAAahdu am aradtum an ya<u>h</u>illa AAalaykum gha<u>d</u>abun min rabbikum faakhlaftum mawAAidee
verses.transliteration_text: FarajaAAa moosa ila qawmihi ghadbana asifan qala ya qawmi alam yaAAidkum rabbukum waAAdan hasanan afatala AAalaykumu alAAahdu am aradtum an yahilla AAalaykum ghadabun min rabbikum faakhlaftum mawAAidee

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ مَآ أَخْلَفْنَا مَوْعِدَكَ بِمَلْكِنَا وَلَـٰكِنَّا حُمِّلْنَآ أَوْزَارًۭا مِّن زِينَةِ ٱلْقَوْمِ فَقَذَفْنَـٰهَا فَكَذَٰلِكَ أَلْقَى ٱلسَّامِرِىُّ
verses.english: They said, ‘We did not fail our tryst with you of our own accord, but we were laden with the weight of those people’s ornaments, and we cast them [into the fire] and so did the Samiri.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qaloo ma akhlafna mawAAidaka bimalkina walakinna hummilna awzaran min zeenati alqawmi faqathafnaha fakathalika alqa alssamiriyyu
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo ma akhlafna mawAAidaka bimalkina walakinna hummilna awzaran min zeenati alqawmi faqathafnaha fakathalika alqa alssamiriyyu

verses.arabic: فَأَخْرَجَ لَهُمْ عِجْلًۭا جَسَدًۭا لَّهُۥ خُوَارٌۭ فَقَالُوا۟ هَـٰذَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمْ وَإِلَـٰهُ مُوسَىٰ فَنَسِىَ
verses.english: Then he produced for them a calf—a [lifeless] body with a low—and they said, This is your god and the god of Moses, so he forgot!
verses.transliteration_html: Faakhraja lahum AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun faqaloo hatha ilahukum wailahu moosa fanasiya
verses.transliteration_text: Faakhraja lahum AAijlan jasadan lahu khuwarun faqaloo hatha ilahukum wailahu moosa fanasiya

verses.arabic: أَفَلَا يَرَوْنَ أَلَّا يَرْجِعُ إِلَيْهِمْ قَوْلًۭا وَلَا يَمْلِكُ لَهُمْ ضَرًّۭا وَلَا نَفْعًۭا
verses.english: Did they not see that it did not answer them, nor could it bring them any benefit or harm?
verses.transliteration_html: Afala yarawna alla yarjiAAu ilayhim qawlan wala yamliku lahum darran wala nafAAan
verses.transliteration_text: Afala yarawna alla yarjiAAu ilayhim qawlan wala yamliku lahum darran wala nafAAan

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ قَالَ لَهُمْ هَـٰرُونُ مِن قَبْلُ يَـٰقَوْمِ إِنَّمَا فُتِنتُم بِهِۦ ۖ وَإِنَّ رَبَّكُمُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ فَٱتَّبِعُونِى وَأَطِيعُوٓا۟ أَمْرِى
verses.english: Aaron had certainly told them earlier, ‘O my people! You are only being tested by it. Indeed your Lord is the All-beneficent. So follow me and obey my command!’
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad qala lahum haroonu min qablu ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabiAAoonee waateeAAoo amree
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad qala lahum haroonu min qablu ya qawmi innama futintum bihi wainna rabbakumu alrrahmanu faittabiAAoonee waateeAAoo amree

verses.arabic: قَالُوا۟ لَن نَّبْرَحَ عَلَيْهِ عَـٰكِفِينَ حَتَّىٰ يَرْجِعَ إِلَيْنَا مُوسَىٰ
verses.english: They had said, ‘We will keep on clinging to it until Moses returns to us.’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>loo lan nabra<u>h</u>a AAalayhi AA<u>a</u>kifeena <u>h</u>att<u>a</u> yarjiAAa ilayn<u>a</u> moos<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qaloo lan nabraha AAalayhi AAakifeena hatta yarjiAAa ilayna moosa

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَـٰهَـٰرُونُ مَا مَنَعَكَ إِذْ رَأَيْتَهُمْ ضَلُّوٓا۟
verses.english: He said, ‘O Aaron! What kept you, when you saw them going astray,
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la y<u>a</u> h<u>a</u>roonu m<u>a</u> manaAAaka i<u>th</u> raaytahum <u>d</u>alloo
verses.transliteration_text: Qala ya haroonu ma manaAAaka ith raaytahum dalloo

verses.arabic: أَلَّا تَتَّبِعَنِ ۖ أَفَعَصَيْتَ أَمْرِى
verses.english: from following me? Did you disobey my command?’
verses.transliteration_html: All<u>a</u> tattabiAAani afaAAa<u>s</u>ayta amree
verses.transliteration_text: Alla tattabiAAani afaAAasayta amree

verses.arabic: قَالَ يَبْنَؤُمَّ لَا تَأْخُذْ بِلِحْيَتِى وَلَا بِرَأْسِىٓ ۖ إِنِّى خَشِيتُ أَن تَقُولَ فَرَّقْتَ بَيْنَ بَنِىٓ إِسْرَٰٓءِيلَ وَلَمْ تَرْقُبْ قَوْلِى
verses.english: He said, ‘O son of my mother! Do not grab my beard or my head! I feared lest you should say, ‘‘You have caused a rift among the Children of Israel and did not heed my word [of advice].’’’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la ya bna omma l<u>a</u> takhu<u>th</u> bili<u>h</u>yatee wal<u>a</u> birasee innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee isr<u>a</u>eela walam tarqub qawlee
verses.transliteration_text: Qala ya bna omma la takhuth bilihyatee wala birasee innee khasheetu an taqoola farraqta bayna banee israeela walam tarqub qawlee

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَمَا خَطْبُكَ يَـٰسَـٰمِرِىُّ
verses.english: He said, ‘What is your business, O Samiri?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu
verses.transliteration_text: Qala fama khatbuka ya samiriyyu

verses.arabic: قَالَ بَصُرْتُ بِمَا لَمْ يَبْصُرُوا۟ بِهِۦ فَقَبَضْتُ قَبْضَةًۭ مِّنْ أَثَرِ ٱلرَّسُولِ فَنَبَذْتُهَا وَكَذَٰلِكَ سَوَّلَتْ لِى نَفْسِى
verses.english: He said, ‘I saw what they did not see. I took a handful [of dust] from the messenger’s trail and threw it. That is how my soul prompted me.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathtuha wakathalika sawwalat lee nafsee
verses.transliteration_text: Qala basurtu bima lam yabsuroo bihi faqabadtu qabdatan min athari alrrasooli fanabathtuha wakathalika sawwalat lee nafsee

verses.arabic: قَالَ فَٱذْهَبْ فَإِنَّ لَكَ فِى ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ أَن تَقُولَ لَا مِسَاسَ ۖ وَإِنَّ لَكَ مَوْعِدًۭا لَّن تُخْلَفَهُۥ ۖ وَٱنظُرْ إِلَىٰٓ إِلَـٰهِكَ ٱلَّذِى ظَلْتَ عَلَيْهِ عَاكِفًۭا ۖ لَّنُحَرِّقَنَّهُۥ ثُمَّ لَنَنسِفَنَّهُۥ فِى ٱلْيَمِّ نَسْفًا
verses.english: He said, ‘Begone! It shall be your [lot] throughout life to say, ‘‘Do not touch me!’’ Indeed, there is a tryst for you which you will not fail to keep! Now look at your god to whom you went on clinging. We will burn it down and then scatter it[s ashes] into the sea.
verses.transliteration_html: Qala faithhab fainna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa wainna laka mawAAidan lan tukhlafahu waonthur ila ilahika allathee thalta AAalayhi AAakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fee alyammi nasfan
verses.transliteration_text: Qala faithhab fainna laka fee alhayati an taqoola la misasa wainna laka mawAAidan lan tukhlafahu waonthur ila ilahika allathee thalta AAalayhi AAakifan lanuharriqannahu thumma lanansifannahu fee alyammi nasfan

verses.arabic: إِنَّمَآ إِلَـٰهُكُمُ ٱللَّهُ ٱلَّذِى لَآ إِلَـٰهَ إِلَّا هُوَ ۚ وَسِعَ كُلَّ شَىْءٍ عِلْمًۭا
verses.english: Indeed your God is Allah. There is no god except Him. He embraces all things in [His] knowledge.’
verses.transliteration_html: Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shayin AAilman
verses.transliteration_text: Innama ilahukumu Allahu allathee la ilaha illa huwa wasiAAa kulla shayin AAilman

verses.arabic: كَذَٰلِكَ نَقُصُّ عَلَيْكَ مِنْ أَنۢبَآءِ مَا قَدْ سَبَقَ ۚ وَقَدْ ءَاتَيْنَـٰكَ مِن لَّدُنَّا ذِكْرًۭا
verses.english: Thus do We relate to you some accounts of what is past. Certainly, We have given you a Reminder from Ourselves.
verses.transliteration_html: Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran
verses.transliteration_text: Kathalika naqussu AAalayka min anbai ma qad sabaqa waqad ataynaka min ladunna thikran

verses.arabic: مَّنْ أَعْرَضَ عَنْهُ فَإِنَّهُۥ يَحْمِلُ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ وِزْرًا
verses.english: Whoever disregards it shall bear a burden [of punishment] on the Day of Resurrection,
verses.transliteration_html: Man aAArada AAanhu fainnahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizran
verses.transliteration_text: Man aAArada AAanhu fainnahu yahmilu yawma alqiyamati wizran

verses.arabic: خَـٰلِدِينَ فِيهِ ۖ وَسَآءَ لَهُمْ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ حِمْلًۭا
verses.english: remaining in it [forever]. Evil is their burden on the Day of Resurrection
verses.transliteration_html: Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himlan
verses.transliteration_text: Khalideena feehi wasaa lahum yawma alqiyamati himlan

verses.arabic: يَوْمَ يُنفَخُ فِى ٱلصُّورِ ۚ وَنَحْشُرُ ٱلْمُجْرِمِينَ يَوْمَئِذٍۢ زُرْقًۭا
verses.english: —the day the Trumpet will be blown; on that day We shall muster the guilty with blind eyes.
verses.transliteration_html: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawmaithin zurqan
verses.transliteration_text: Yawma yunfakhu fee alssoori wanahshuru almujrimeena yawmaithin zurqan

verses.arabic: يَتَخَـٰفَتُونَ بَيْنَهُمْ إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا عَشْرًۭا
verses.english: They will whisper to one another: ‘You have stayed only for ten [days].’
verses.transliteration_html: Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran
verses.transliteration_text: Yatakhafatoona baynahum in labithtum illa AAashran

verses.arabic: نَّحْنُ أَعْلَمُ بِمَا يَقُولُونَ إِذْ يَقُولُ أَمْثَلُهُمْ طَرِيقَةً إِن لَّبِثْتُمْ إِلَّا يَوْمًۭا
verses.english: We know best what they will say, when the smartest of them in approach will say, ‘You stayed only a day!’
verses.transliteration_html: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawman
verses.transliteration_text: Nahnu aAAlamu bima yaqooloona ith yaqoolu amthaluhum tareeqatan in labithtum illa yawman

verses.arabic: وَيَسْـَٔلُونَكَ عَنِ ٱلْجِبَالِ فَقُلْ يَنسِفُهَا رَبِّى نَسْفًۭا
verses.english: They question you concerning the mountains. Say, ‘My Lord will scatter them [like dust].’
verses.transliteration_html: Wayasaloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfan
verses.transliteration_text: Wayasaloonaka AAani aljibali faqul yansifuha rabbee nasfan

verses.arabic: فَيَذَرُهَا قَاعًۭا صَفْصَفًۭا
verses.english: Then He will leave it a level plain.
verses.transliteration_html: Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafan
verses.transliteration_text: Fayatharuha qaAAan safsafan

verses.arabic: لَّا تَرَىٰ فِيهَا عِوَجًۭا وَلَآ أَمْتًۭا
verses.english: You will not see any crookedness or unevenness in it.
verses.transliteration_html: La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amtan
verses.transliteration_text: La tara feeha AAiwajan wala amtan

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ يَتَّبِعُونَ ٱلدَّاعِىَ لَا عِوَجَ لَهُۥ ۖ وَخَشَعَتِ ٱلْأَصْوَاتُ لِلرَّحْمَـٰنِ فَلَا تَسْمَعُ إِلَّا هَمْسًۭا
verses.english: On that day they will follow the summoner without zigzagging. Their voices will be muted before the All-beneficent, and you will hear nothing but a murmur.
verses.transliteration_html: Yawmaithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati alaswatu lilrrahmani fala tasmaAAu illa hamsan
verses.transliteration_text: Yawmaithin yattabiAAoona alddaAAiya la AAiwaja lahu wakhashaAAati alaswatu lilrrahmani fala tasmaAAu illa hamsan

verses.arabic: يَوْمَئِذٍۢ لَّا تَنفَعُ ٱلشَّفَـٰعَةُ إِلَّا مَنْ أَذِنَ لَهُ ٱلرَّحْمَـٰنُ وَرَضِىَ لَهُۥ قَوْلًۭا
verses.english: Intercession will not avail that day except from him whom the All-beneficent allows and approves of his word.
verses.transliteration_html: Yawmaithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawlan
verses.transliteration_text: Yawmaithin la tanfaAAu alshshafaAAatu illa man athina lahu alrrahmanu waradiya lahu qawlan

verses.arabic: يَعْلَمُ مَا بَيْنَ أَيْدِيهِمْ وَمَا خَلْفَهُمْ وَلَا يُحِيطُونَ بِهِۦ عِلْمًۭا
verses.english: He knows what is before them and behind them, though they do not comprehend Him in their knowledge.
verses.transliteration_html: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilman
verses.transliteration_text: YaAAlamu ma bayna aydeehim wama khalfahum wala yuheetoona bihi AAilman

verses.arabic: ۞ وَعَنَتِ ٱلْوُجُوهُ لِلْحَىِّ ٱلْقَيُّومِ ۖ وَقَدْ خَابَ مَنْ حَمَلَ ظُلْمًۭا
verses.english: All faces shall be humbled before the Living One, the All-sustainer, and those who bear [the burden of] wrongdoing will fail.
verses.transliteration_html: WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulman
verses.transliteration_text: WaAAanati alwujoohu lilhayyi alqayyoomi waqad khaba man hamala thulman

verses.arabic: وَمَن يَعْمَلْ مِنَ ٱلصَّـٰلِحَـٰتِ وَهُوَ مُؤْمِنٌۭ فَلَا يَخَافُ ظُلْمًۭا وَلَا هَضْمًۭا
verses.english: But whoever does righteous deeds, being faithful, will neither fear any injustice or disparagement.
verses.transliteration_html: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadman
verses.transliteration_text: Waman yaAAmal mina alssalihati wahuwa muminun fala yakhafu thulman wala hadman

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ أَنزَلْنَـٰهُ قُرْءَانًا عَرَبِيًّۭا وَصَرَّفْنَا فِيهِ مِنَ ٱلْوَعِيدِ لَعَلَّهُمْ يَتَّقُونَ أَوْ يُحْدِثُ لَهُمْ ذِكْرًۭا
verses.english: Thus We have sent it down as an Arabic Quran and We have paraphrased the warnings in it variously so that they may be Godwary, or it may prompt them to remembrance.
verses.transliteration_html: Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran
verses.transliteration_text: Wakathalika anzalnahu quranan AAarabiyyan wasarrafna feehi mina alwaAAeedi laAAallahum yattaqoona aw yuhdithu lahum thikran

verses.arabic: فَتَعَـٰلَى ٱللَّهُ ٱلْمَلِكُ ٱلْحَقُّ ۗ وَلَا تَعْجَلْ بِٱلْقُرْءَانِ مِن قَبْلِ أَن يُقْضَىٰٓ إِلَيْكَ وَحْيُهُۥ ۖ وَقُل رَّبِّ زِدْنِى عِلْمًۭا
verses.english: So exalted is Allah, the True Sovereign. Do not hasten with the Quran before its revelation is completed for you, and say, ‘My Lord! Increase me in knowledge.’
verses.transliteration_html: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilman
verses.transliteration_text: FataAAala Allahu almaliku alhaqqu wala taAAjal bialqurani min qabli an yuqda ilayka wahyuhu waqul rabbi zidnee AAilman

verses.arabic: وَلَقَدْ عَهِدْنَآ إِلَىٰٓ ءَادَمَ مِن قَبْلُ فَنَسِىَ وَلَمْ نَجِدْ لَهُۥ عَزْمًۭا
verses.english: Certainly We had enjoined Adam earlier; but he forgot, and We did not find any resoluteness in him.
verses.transliteration_html: Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazman
verses.transliteration_text: Walaqad AAahidna ila adama min qablu fanasiya walam najid lahu AAazman

verses.arabic: وَإِذْ قُلْنَا لِلْمَلَـٰٓئِكَةِ ٱسْجُدُوا۟ لِـَٔادَمَ فَسَجَدُوٓا۟ إِلَّآ إِبْلِيسَ أَبَىٰ
verses.english: When We said to the angels, ‘Prostrate before Adam,’ they prostrated, but not Iblis: he refused.
verses.transliteration_html: Wai<u>th</u> quln<u>a</u> lilmal<u>a</u>ikati osjudoo li<u>a</u>dama fasajadoo ill<u>a</u> ibleesa ab<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Waith qulna lilmalaikati osjudoo liadama fasajadoo illa ibleesa aba

verses.arabic: فَقُلْنَا يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ إِنَّ هَـٰذَا عَدُوٌّۭ لَّكَ وَلِزَوْجِكَ فَلَا يُخْرِجَنَّكُمَا مِنَ ٱلْجَنَّةِ فَتَشْقَىٰٓ
verses.english: We said, ‘O Adam! This is indeed an enemy of yours and your mate’s. So do not let him expel you from paradise, or you will be miserable.
verses.transliteration_html: Faquln<u>a</u> y<u>a</u> <u>a</u>damu inna h<u>atha</u> AAaduwwun laka walizawjika fal<u>a</u> yukhrijannakum<u>a</u> mina aljannati fatashq<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Faqulna ya adamu inna hatha AAaduwwun laka walizawjika fala yukhrijannakuma mina aljannati fatashqa

verses.arabic: إِنَّ لَكَ أَلَّا تَجُوعَ فِيهَا وَلَا تَعْرَىٰ
verses.english: You will neither be hungry in it nor naked.
verses.transliteration_html: Inna laka all<u>a</u> tajooAAa feeh<u>a</u> wal<u>a</u> taAAr<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Inna laka alla tajooAAa feeha wala taAAra

verses.arabic: وَأَنَّكَ لَا تَظْمَؤُا۟ فِيهَا وَلَا تَضْحَىٰ
verses.english: You will neither be thirsty in it, nor suffer from [the heat of] the sun.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waannaka la tathmao feeha wala tadha
verses.transliteration_text: Waannaka la tathmao feeha wala tadha

verses.arabic: فَوَسْوَسَ إِلَيْهِ ٱلشَّيْطَـٰنُ قَالَ يَـٰٓـَٔادَمُ هَلْ أَدُلُّكَ عَلَىٰ شَجَرَةِ ٱلْخُلْدِ وَمُلْكٍۢ لَّا يَبْلَىٰ
verses.english: Then Satan tempted him. He said, ‘O Adam! Shall I show you the tree of immortality, and an imperishable kingdom?’
verses.transliteration_html: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla
verses.transliteration_text: Fawaswasa ilayhi alshshaytanu qala ya adamu hal adulluka AAala shajarati alkhuldi wamulkin la yabla

verses.arabic: فَأَكَلَا مِنْهَا فَبَدَتْ لَهُمَا سَوْءَٰتُهُمَا وَطَفِقَا يَخْصِفَانِ عَلَيْهِمَا مِن وَرَقِ ٱلْجَنَّةِ ۚ وَعَصَىٰٓ ءَادَمُ رَبَّهُۥ فَغَوَىٰ
verses.english: So they both ate of it, and their nakedness became evident to them, and they began to stitch over themselves with the leaves of paradise. Adam disobeyed his Lord, and went amiss.
verses.transliteration_html: Faakal<u>a</u> minh<u>a</u> fabadat lahum<u>a</u> saw<u>a</u>tuhum<u>a</u> wa<u>t</u>afiq<u>a</u> yakh<u>s</u>if<u>a</u>ni AAalayhim<u>a</u> min waraqi aljannati waAAa<u>sa</u> <u>a</u>damu rabbahu faghaw<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Faakala minha fabadat lahuma sawatuhuma watafiqa yakhsifani AAalayhima min waraqi aljannati waAAasa adamu rabbahu faghawa

verses.arabic: ثُمَّ ٱجْتَبَـٰهُ رَبُّهُۥ فَتَابَ عَلَيْهِ وَهَدَىٰ
verses.english: Then his Lord chose him, and turned to him clemently, and guided him.
verses.transliteration_html: Thumma ijtab<u>a</u>hu rabbuhu fat<u>a</u>ba AAalayhi wahad<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Thumma ijtabahu rabbuhu fataba AAalayhi wahada

verses.arabic: قَالَ ٱهْبِطَا مِنْهَا جَمِيعًۢا ۖ بَعْضُكُمْ لِبَعْضٍ عَدُوٌّۭ ۖ فَإِمَّا يَأْتِيَنَّكُم مِّنِّى هُدًۭى فَمَنِ ٱتَّبَعَ هُدَاىَ فَلَا يَضِلُّ وَلَا يَشْقَىٰ
verses.english: He said, ‘Get down both of you from it, all together, being enemies of one another! Yet, should any guidance come to you from Me, those who follow My guidance will not go astray, nor will they be miserable.
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la ihbi<u>ta</u> minh<u>a</u> jameeAAan baAA<u>d</u>ukum libaAA<u>d</u>in AAaduwwun faimm<u>a</u> yatiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittabaAAa hud<u>a</u>ya fal<u>a</u> ya<u>d</u>illu wal<u>a</u> yashq<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala ihbita minha jameeAAan baAAdukum libaAAdin AAaduwwun faimma yatiyannakum minnee hudan famani ittabaAAa hudaya fala yadillu wala yashqa

verses.arabic: وَمَنْ أَعْرَضَ عَن ذِكْرِى فَإِنَّ لَهُۥ مَعِيشَةًۭ ضَنكًۭا وَنَحْشُرُهُۥ يَوْمَ ٱلْقِيَـٰمَةِ أَعْمَىٰ
verses.english: But whoever disregards My remembrance, his shall be a wretched life, and We shall raise him blind on the Day of Resurrection.’
verses.transliteration_html: Waman aAArada AAan thikree fainna lahu maAAeeshatan dankan wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAman
verses.transliteration_text: Waman aAArada AAan thikree fainna lahu maAAeeshatan dankan wanahshuruhu yawma alqiyamati aAAman

verses.arabic: قَالَ رَبِّ لِمَ حَشَرْتَنِىٓ أَعْمَىٰ وَقَدْ كُنتُ بَصِيرًۭا
verses.english: He will say, ‘My Lord! Why have You raised me blind, though I used to see?’
verses.transliteration_html: Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran
verses.transliteration_text: Qala rabbi lima hashartanee aAAma waqad kuntu baseeran

verses.arabic: قَالَ كَذَٰلِكَ أَتَتْكَ ءَايَـٰتُنَا فَنَسِيتَهَا ۖ وَكَذَٰلِكَ ٱلْيَوْمَ تُنسَىٰ
verses.english: He will say: ‘So it is. Our signs came to you, but you forgot them, and so you will be forgotten today.’
verses.transliteration_html: Q<u>a</u>la ka<u>tha</u>lika atatka <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tun<u>a</u> fanaseetah<u>a</u> waka<u>tha</u>lika alyawma tuns<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Qala kathalika atatka ayatuna fanaseetaha wakathalika alyawma tunsa

verses.arabic: وَكَذَٰلِكَ نَجْزِى مَنْ أَسْرَفَ وَلَمْ يُؤْمِنۢ بِـَٔايَـٰتِ رَبِّهِۦ ۚ وَلَعَذَابُ ٱلْـَٔاخِرَةِ أَشَدُّ وَأَبْقَىٰٓ
verses.english: Thus do We requite those who transgress and do not believe in the signs of their Lord, and the punishment of the Hereafter is severer and more lasting.
verses.transliteration_html: Waka<u>tha</u>lika najzee man asrafa walam yumin bi<u>a</u>y<u>a</u>ti rabbihi walaAAa<u>tha</u>bu al<u>a</u>khirati ashaddu waabq<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Wakathalika najzee man asrafa walam yumin biayati rabbihi walaAAathabu alakhirati ashaddu waabqa

verses.arabic: أَفَلَمْ يَهْدِ لَهُمْ كَمْ أَهْلَكْنَا قَبْلَهُم مِّنَ ٱلْقُرُونِ يَمْشُونَ فِى مَسَـٰكِنِهِمْ ۗ إِنَّ فِى ذَٰلِكَ لَـَٔايَـٰتٍۢ لِّأُو۟لِى ٱلنُّهَىٰ
verses.english: Does it not dawn upon them how many generations We have destroyed before them, amid [the ruins of] whose dwellings they walk? There are indeed signs in this for those who have reason.
verses.transliteration_html: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha
verses.transliteration_text: Afalam yahdi lahum kam ahlakna qablahum mina alqurooni yamshoona fee masakinihim inna fee thalika laayatin liolee alnnuha

verses.arabic: وَلَوْلَا كَلِمَةٌۭ سَبَقَتْ مِن رَّبِّكَ لَكَانَ لِزَامًۭا وَأَجَلٌۭ مُّسَمًّۭى
verses.english: Were it not for a prior decree of your Lord and a specified time, [their doom] would have attended [their guilt].
verses.transliteration_html: Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajalun musamman
verses.transliteration_text: Walawla kalimatun sabaqat min rabbika lakana lizaman waajalun musamman

verses.arabic: فَٱصْبِرْ عَلَىٰ مَا يَقُولُونَ وَسَبِّحْ بِحَمْدِ رَبِّكَ قَبْلَ طُلُوعِ ٱلشَّمْسِ وَقَبْلَ غُرُوبِهَا ۖ وَمِنْ ءَانَآئِ ٱلَّيْلِ فَسَبِّحْ وَأَطْرَافَ ٱلنَّهَارِ لَعَلَّكَ تَرْضَىٰ
verses.english: So be patient with what they say, and celebrate the praise of your Lord before the rising of the sun and before the sunset, and glorify Him in watches of the night and at the day’s ends, that you may be pleased.
verses.transliteration_html: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha wamin anai allayli fasabbih waatrafa alnnahari laAAallaka tarda
verses.transliteration_text: Faisbir AAala ma yaqooloona wasabbih bihamdi rabbika qabla tulooAAi alshshamsi waqabla ghuroobiha wamin anai allayli fasabbih waatrafa alnnahari laAAallaka tarda

verses.arabic: وَلَا تَمُدَّنَّ عَيْنَيْكَ إِلَىٰ مَا مَتَّعْنَا بِهِۦٓ أَزْوَٰجًۭا مِّنْهُمْ زَهْرَةَ ٱلْحَيَوٰةِ ٱلدُّنْيَا لِنَفْتِنَهُمْ فِيهِ ۚ وَرِزْقُ رَبِّكَ خَيْرٌۭ وَأَبْقَىٰ
verses.english: Do not extend your glance toward what We have provided certain groups of them as a glitter of the life of this world, so that We may test them thereby. The provision of your Lord is better and more lasting.
verses.transliteration_html: Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum feehi warizqu rabbika khayrun waabqa
verses.transliteration_text: Wala tamuddanna AAaynayka ila ma mattaAAna bihi azwajan minhum zahrata alhayati alddunya linaftinahum feehi warizqu rabbika khayrun waabqa

verses.arabic: وَأْمُرْ أَهْلَكَ بِٱلصَّلَوٰةِ وَٱصْطَبِرْ عَلَيْهَا ۖ لَا نَسْـَٔلُكَ رِزْقًۭا ۖ نَّحْنُ نَرْزُقُكَ ۗ وَٱلْعَـٰقِبَةُ لِلتَّقْوَىٰ
verses.english: And bid your family to prayer and be steadfast in maintaining it. We do not ask any provision of you: it is We who provide for you, and to Godwariness belongs the ultimate outcome [in the Hereafter].
verses.transliteration_html: Wamur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa
verses.transliteration_text: Wamur ahlaka bialssalati waistabir AAalayha la nasaluka rizqan nahnu narzuquka waalAAaqibatu lilttaqwa

verses.arabic: وَقَالُوا۟ لَوْلَا يَأْتِينَا بِـَٔايَةٍۢ مِّن رَّبِّهِۦٓ ۚ أَوَلَمْ تَأْتِهِم بَيِّنَةُ مَا فِى ٱلصُّحُفِ ٱلْأُولَىٰ
verses.english: They say, ‘Why does he not bring us a sign from his Lord?’ Has there not come to them a clear proof in that which is in the former scriptures?
verses.transliteration_html: Waqaloo lawla yateena biayatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhufi aloola
verses.transliteration_text: Waqaloo lawla yateena biayatin min rabbihi awalam tatihim bayyinatu ma fee alssuhufi aloola

verses.arabic: وَلَوْ أَنَّآ أَهْلَكْنَـٰهُم بِعَذَابٍۢ مِّن قَبْلِهِۦ لَقَالُوا۟ رَبَّنَا لَوْلَآ أَرْسَلْتَ إِلَيْنَا رَسُولًۭا فَنَتَّبِعَ ءَايَـٰتِكَ مِن قَبْلِ أَن نَّذِلَّ وَنَخْزَىٰ
verses.english: Had We destroyed them with a punishment before it, they would have surely said, ‘Our Lord! Why did You not send us an apostle so that we might have followed Your signs before we were abased and disgraced?’
verses.transliteration_html: Walaw ann<u>a</u> ahlakn<u>a</u>hum biAAa<u>tha</u>bin min qablihi laq<u>a</u>loo rabban<u>a</u> lawl<u>a</u> arsalta ilayn<u>a</u> rasoolan fanattabiAAa <u>a</u>y<u>a</u>tika min qabli an na<u>th</u>illa wanakhz<u>a</u>
verses.transliteration_text: Walaw anna ahlaknahum biAAathabin min qablihi laqaloo rabbana lawla arsalta ilayna rasoolan fanattabiAAa ayatika min qabli an nathilla wanakhza

verses.arabic: قُلْ كُلٌّۭ مُّتَرَبِّصٌۭ فَتَرَبَّصُوا۟ ۖ فَسَتَعْلَمُونَ مَنْ أَصْحَـٰبُ ٱلصِّرَٰطِ ٱلسَّوِىِّ وَمَنِ ٱهْتَدَىٰ
verses.english: Say, ‘Everyone [of us] is waiting. So wait! Soon you will know who are the people of the right path, and who is [rightly] guided.’
verses.transliteration_html: Qul kullun mutarabbisun fatarabbasoo fasataAAlamoona man ashabu alssirati alssawiyyi wamani ihtada
